lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the re-plan loop, pane teardown, and durable escalation into the sidecar

openQuestions: The ship-stalled marker precedent gitignore gap noted in US-002's handoff (.cam-ship-stalled.json missing from both .gitignore and templates/.gitignore) remains unaddressed; still out of scope for this story's diff. US-005 (boot-doc surfacing) does not touch .gitignore either, per its notes; if a future story adds .cam-plan-escalated.json to .gitignore, mirror it into templates/.gitignore too and fix the pre-existing ship-stalled gap at the same time (do not silently skip because it's 'someone else's mess', per patterns.md 'Thinning a phase-signal command doc' collateral-surface discipline).

makeTeardownPlanPanesFn / makeWriteEscalationMarkerFn / runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan (src/commands/sidecar.ts) are NOT exported: this story's US-004 wiring is verified only via a source-text oracle (test/supervisor/plan/plan-sidecar-replan-wiring.test.ts), mirroring the established convention for makePlanPaneHelpers/buildPlanContainerOpts (not exported, oracle-tested). If a future story needs stronger behavioral coverage of the real kill-pane/marker-write side effects (beyond the already-thorough runPlanPhaseWithReplan seam-call-count tests in plan-runner-replan.test.ts), consider a real-tmux integration test mirroring test/integration/ensure-worker-pane-selfheal.test.ts or test/integration/tmux-introspect.test.ts, gated on tmux availability.
nextStoryContext: US-004 wired runPlanPhaseWithReplan (US-003) into makeProductionPlanPhaseFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts): teardownPlanPanesFn is now makeTeardownPlanPanesFn(claudeDir) (real 'tmux kill-pane', fresh readWorkerPaneMarker read, never respawn-pane -k, try/catch silent no-op -- verbatim mirror of host.ts:398 teardownWorkerPaneFn) and writeEscalationMarkerFn is now makeWriteEscalationMarkerFn(claudeDir) (stamps writtenAt: new Date().toISOString() and calls writePlanEscalatedMarker(join(claudeDir, PLAN_ESCALATED_FILENAME), marker) from plan-escalation.ts, US-002). Because wiring all the runPlanPhaseWithReplan deps inline pushed makeProductionPlanPhaseFn over biome's 80-line limit, the ENTIRE options-bag assembly was extracted into a new `runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan(deps: PlanWorkerRunDeps): PlanPhaseResult` helper (grouped-deps interface, not just the two new seams) -- makeProductionPlanPhaseFn now just builds the grouped-deps object literal and calls this helper once. runPostAuditAction (plan-runner.ts) gained: (a) a `plan-escalated` branch (checked after the existing `audit-blocked` branch, same shape: notifyFn('[cam] plan escalated: <summary>') + best-effort escalateFn, returns { kind: 'escalated' }, no branch/commit/flip -- the durable marker for this terminal was ALREADY written unconditionally inside runPlanPhaseWithReplan before runPostAuditAction is ever invoked, so its persistence never depends on notifyFn/escalateFn); (b) a new optional `removeEscalationMarkerFn?: () => void` field on RunPostAuditOptions, called exactly once on the converging proceed-branch path (audit-approved -> branch-created), BEFORE the git checkout -b call -- production wiring is in sidecar.ts's runPostPlanActions: `removeEscalationMarkerFn: () => removePlanEscalatedMarker(join(o.claudeDir, PLAN_ESCALATED_FILENAME))`. US-005 (orchestrator derives the plan escalation on wake) is a DOCS-ONLY story: add a boot-context read step to templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (item modeled on the existing .cam-ship-stalled.json step -- same file, same list, same 'do NOT delete it yourself' wording pattern) that reads .claude/.cam-plan-escalated.json and surfaces issueId + roundsCompleted + summary as an opening blocker line when present; a clean boot (marker absent) stays clean. The PlanEscalatedMarker shape (issueId: string, summary: string, findings: PlanVerdictFinding[], roundsCompleted: number, writtenAt: string) is exported from src/supervisor/plan-escalation.ts (US-002) -- read it via `git show main:.claude/.cam-plan-escalated.json` per the 'Orchestrator reads state files from main' pattern if the doc step needs to reference a read command, OR simply document the read as a Read-tool call against .claude/.cam-plan-escalated.json directly (it's a local marker file under .claude/, not a scripts/cam/ backlog file committed to main -- confirm which applies before writing the boot step, since the ship-stalled precedent step's exact read mechanism should be copied verbatim for symmetry). After editing templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, run `bun run embed-vendor` to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts, then `bun run embed-vendor:check` to confirm no drift; the .claude/agents/ runtime mirror should also be updated per the 'Agent-prompt self-hosting pattern' (US-001, CAM-53) if that mirror exists and is out of sync (check .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md's presence before editing templates/ only).

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 only wires existing intra-repo modules (plan-runner.ts's US-003 loop driver, plan-escalation.ts's US-002 marker I/O, and sidecar.ts's tmux/fs seams) together; no new external npm library surface was exercised. tmux CLI usage (kill-pane) mirrors the already-validated host.ts precedent verbatim, no new tmux flag introduced.
